fps.Name: FPS (Experimental)
fps.Description: Experimental fixed 60 FPS patch for BOTW 1.9.0, Build ID CD57B23FA4BBAD65803D9788C01821EE. Uses native game timing. IPSwitch export confirmed at 60 FPS in Eden; broader gameplay testing pending. This is not UltraCam or dynamic FPS. Keep emulator speed at 100%. Disable other FPS mods and the 1.6 UltraCam mod. Graphics settings are controlled by your emulator.
